run_DemoPredictor_on_image: run a DemoPredictor on a BGR image to get model predictions with resizing and preprocessing
run_VisualizationDemo_on_image: run a VisualizationDemo on an image to get predictions and visualized output with instance or segmentation overlays
run_VisualizationDemo_on_video: run a VisualizationDemo on a video stream to yield visualized frames with predictions drawn on each frame
create_DemoPredictor_with_model: create a DemoPredictor from a trained model with configurable min and max test size and input format
create_VisualizationDemo_with_config: create a VisualizationDemo from a config file with optional parallel processing and instance coloring mode
